property_summary: For any callee address whose fallback/receive either succeeds or reverts, the reference contract forwards by reverting iff the callee reverted (i.e. forward returns successfully exactly when the low-level call succeeded); the mutant inverts this: it reverts when the callee call succeeds, so there exist inputs (a callee that reverts) that make the mutant's observed success flag opposite the reference.
change_summary: Replace the call expression with a low-level call that sends calldata but ensures the boolean is ignored by flipping to a revert on success via an explicit if, causing opposite revert behavior.
